new: Investment comparison: after a run, see which extra 5★ pulls (constellations, R1 signature weapons) raise team DPS the most for a number of pulls.
Lock a member's weapon straight from its row in KQM Setup.
The ER calculator shows how much energy each teammate gives.
improved: The weapon lock picker is compact: search with the keyboard, weapons grouped by rarity with their substat, and the refinement set as you pick.
Artifact standards say whether they use average or highest roll values, and the most crit value their substats reach.
fixed: Vodyanitsa's Skill makes a particle with each Horn of Spring's Call attack (6 a Skill, not 1), so her teammates need less ER.
The rotation writer plays Bursts set to every 2nd or 3rd rotation in the ER calculator the way the optimizer does, and says so.

new: Damage share shows how long Cryo Resonance (+15% CRIT Rate) is up in teams with two Cryo members: its share of the rotation's time and of its damage.
Damage share shows the Polestar Field too: its uptime and average stacks, over time and by damage (Anastasya's +1 included).
fixed: Anastasya's Normal Attacks in Honor apply Cryo on every other hit (was every third).

new: Team variants are easier to find: a Team variants button above Rotation on the KQM tab shows how many you have saved, and KQM results have a Compare variants button beside Share.
improved: The rotation optimizer suggests sturdier rotations: a pick that only wins on one exact frame is checked with small timing changes, supports stick to moves that make sense for them (no idle dashes, jumps or long Normal Attack strings), pointless cancels are dropped, and Energy Recharge changes are priced from your own builds.

Team optimize Burst Scenarios: skipping a Burst is scored on its own, your written rotation stays the baseline, and each member's unmet requirements are named. The rotation search says which DPS each gain is measured against.
Team optimize on phones: the rotation writer and run setup fit narrow screens. Setup says your edits save as you go and offers Reset edits, and the writer marks drafts you can discard.
Gear ranking runs when you ask for it and can be stopped, saved builds can be restored after a reload, and discarding a result asks first. Runs no longer freeze the page while they search.
Gear rankings in the build inspector and Top builds have a clearer, more compact layout.
fixed: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers is counted correctly on rotations shorter than 20 s (it triggers every other rotation), and its on-field share is shown.
Sandrone at C1 and above: the rotation writer suggests CA[beams=6] (C0 keeps CA[beams=2]).
Blazing Lionfang's passive uses the official English text (Revitalizing Spark).
Beta V5 changes updated: Anastasya's C2 Honor bonus is 130% of the original DMG (was 125%).
Beta V5 changes updated: Danica's C4 Energy comes only from the other party members' Stellar-Conduct hits under her Royal Aegis, not her own.
Beta V5 changes updated: official English names for Danica's and Anastasya's constellations and for the Epochal Advent and Empyrean Sojourn pieces.

new: Batch version combinations in KQM Theorycrafting: pick a pool of up to 8 characters (with core member locks, 1-click common teammate suggestions, per-character constellations C0–C6, and signature weapon refinements Any / No sig / R1–R5) to generate all team combinations at once with auto-filled rotations and 1-click action presets.

Versions now stay hidden from the main Teams tab by default so creating variations doesn't clutter your teams list. Pin individual versions to Teams whenever you want, or toggle Show versions right from the Teams page.
Multi-select and bulk delete versions directly from the Versions sidebar.
improved: Redesigned the Versions sidebar with a wider layout, search and character filters, Best DPS and Original sorting, inline rotation previews, and rounded character portraits showing each member's constellation and signature refinement right on the portrait.
Share comparison sheets open and update much faster by rendering directly to canvas, caching decoded icons, and encoding the watermarked PNG lazily in the background.
Team optimize runs faster when comparing weapons for a written rotation, especially when Sacrificial weapons are available.

new: Sacrificial weapons can reset Elemental Skills in written rotations. Add an optional E? to cast again when the Skill is ready and continue immediately when it is still on cooldown.

The rotation writer shows how often the extra Skill played and lets you compare cast and skipped timelines. Compare ER with Sacrificial shows the no-reset target alongside the average with resets. Automatic ER uses the no-reset target.
fixed: Mavuika’s Flamestrider Charged Attack finisher now counts when it ends a rotation. Follow-up actions also respect its hitlag and recovery.
Vesna’s Charged Attack now requires an open Normal Attack combo, so the rotation simulator flags inputs that the game cannot execute.
Burst scenarios progress now advances smoothly without jumping backward between weapons, rounds, or repair passes.

Optimize rotation now uses your team's live ER calculator settings, Burst frequency, and constellations when scoring and confirming builds, drops rotations whose real builds fail requirements or lose DPS, and marks unconfirmed rotations that need more ER.
Team optimize waits for automatic ER to update after switching rotations and explains in the Below current tooltip when current builds miss a requirement such as Min ER.

improved: Team optimize runs noticeably faster and keeps the page smoother while searching, especially for alternative weapon and artifact set rankings and repeat runs.
fixed: Team optimize no longer puts the main carry on an energy weapon like Favonius in round 1 just because a teammate's starting artifacts miss their ER requirement before that teammate has been optimized; when an energy weapon is genuinely needed, lower-damage supports now take it first.

new: Burst scenarios (Team optimize and KQM): compare using a character's Burst every rotation, every 2nd or 3rd rotation, or skipping it (with an optional replacement action such as N4), recalculating ER requirements and builds for each scenario and ranking them by team DPS.
improved: Optimize rotation now shows your current rotation's length alongside its ER needs, so you can compare it directly with the suggested rotations.

fixed: Team Optimize now ranks up to three 2-piece + 2-piece artifact builds per character alongside 4-piece builds. Select a pair to compare its team damage.
Varesa's Skill charges now recharge one at a time. The rotation also ends Fiery Passion when she swaps out after a plunge that spent her Nightsoul points.

improved: Team optimize is much faster with big inventories: Quick searches in full only the weapons that can come close to the best (Full still tries every one), and skips weaker copies of the same weapon.
Team optimize stops at once when a member's minimum, like Energy Recharge, can't be reached with any of their weapons, and says how far off it is.
A built-in Melt rotation for Mavuika, Citlali, Xilonen and Bennett.
fixed: Artifact sets: turning every set off but one (or Only) now makes every build wear 4 pieces of it, instead of still allowing mixed sets.
Mavuika: tapping her Skill during Nightsoul's Blessing switches form without extra damage or particles, and a cancelled Charged Attack no longer fires its finisher later.
Faruzan makes particles only from Pressurized Collapses (5.5 s cooldown, C6 included), each going to whoever is on the field.
Citlali's Nightsoul points no longer go past 100.

new: Weapons can be limited to the members you choose ("Usable by" on each weapon), in Team optimize and KQM: a Favonius is only tried on the members you want.

ER is now an explicit choice, Automatic or Manual, in Team optimize and KQM. In Automatic, Favonius and other energy weapons show what they save each member right on their card, where their triggers can be set too.
Rotation writer: a warning shows when the rotation waits for cooldowns (what waits, and how long), and the timeline can show every rotation played, with each wait where it happens.
improved: Optional Bursts (Q?, Q/N3, EQ/E) count as every 2nd Burst in the ER calculator.
Result cards are easier to read and show each member's ER requirement.
Ticking weapons, members and sets in the weapon and set lists is instant.
Rotation search no longer tries a held Skill on characters who can't hold it, and tries every Normal Attack length inside repeats such as 2[N1 C].
fixed: Using a rotation no longer turns buffs such as Cryo resonance back on in your team settings: the rotation still times them hit by hit, shown as "From rotation".
Manual ER stays Manual when the rotation changes.
The ER calculator's dropdowns open on top of the calculator again.

improved: Team optimize stays responsive on phones while it runs: the page no longer freezes for a second at a time.
fixed: Cryo Traveler: Charged Attack: Freezing Ice without Stellar Radiance showed as a plain white Charged Attack. It now shows as Freezing Ice, in Cryo.

new: Team optimize results now show Top builds and Damage share, as the KQM tab does: the best team, then the best builds that change one member's weapon or set. Pick one to see it.
After a run, pick a member to try its other weapons and artifact sets: each is ranked by team damage, and picking one shows the team with it.
Team optimize turns on weapon and artifact set effects automatically where you haven't set them, and times set effects from the rotation, as KQM does. Anything you set yourself still wins.
improved: Damage share by element now keeps Stellar and Lunar damage apart from their element's other damage (for example Cryo and Stellar Cryo, Electro and Lunar-Charged).
The Optimize team dialog asks for the best build or all builds, instead of a number.
Team optimize results header is quieter: a larger team DPS figure, and warnings, your picks and Undo equip as small labels beside it instead of extra lines.
Team optimize results no longer jump while the members' other builds are ranked: a label shows the progress, and What raises team damage comes in once they are done.
Team optimize results appear with a short animation.
fixed: Clicking a Burst on the rotation timeline opens its hit when the hit lands after the member's next action.
Arlecchino's Masque Normal Attack bonus and C1 now need 30% Bond of Life or more.
Citlali's C1 Normal Attack bonus goes to the active member only.

improved: Optimize team dialog redesigned: each member on one line with its sets, set effects, main stats and minimum ER (100% unless you set one), the inventory options side by side, and the weapons list opens at once.

Artifact sets dialog is simpler: one switch per set in alphabetical order, set effects turned on right in the set's row (which also lets the optimizer use that set), and the 2-piece/4-piece choices under Advanced.
Mixed builds (one or no set bonus) are always considered now: the optimizer keeps them only when they are better.
A member's Constraints button opens just its minimum stats.

fixed: Yae Miko's Charged Attack deals one hit per cast, as in the game (it was counted twice).
Danica C2: her first swap-in of a fight plays Will to Protect (Maid: Royal Guard and a Storm Anchor) even without a full Will to Cleanse or an Anchor out, as in the game.
Valeriy's Burst fires 21 shells, starting about 2 s after it's cast, as in the game (it fired too many, too soon). Its Impact Momentum gain starts with its turret too.

Rotations: a character's buffs from their Skill or Burst now count only when the rotation uses that Skill or Burst. Before, a buff left on in the character's own settings could apply to a rotation without it, so some teams showed more damage than they would deal.

improved: The KQM tab's Versions sidebar always shows Run all, so you can run every version again even when they're all up to date.
fixed: Team optimize: opening a grouped attack row no longer crashes the page on some imported teams.

improved: Beta V4 changes updated: Anastasya's Blessed Spear Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl DMG is lower (hits 1–3 ×0.84, hits 4–5 ×0.88), and so are the 1st and 2nd hits of her Burst's Palestar Edict: Doom.
Beta V4 changes updated: Danica's C2 Maid: Cleaner bonus is 500% of her ATK, casting her Skill again no longer refreshes a Storm Anchor already out, and her Skill particles drop once every 16 s.
Beta V4 changes updated: Silverdawn refunds Energy once every 18 s and also works off-field, and Torrents of Spring's enhancement also comes from triggering a Stellar-Conduct reaction.

fixed: Cyno's C1: a Judication now gives his Normal Attack SPD bonus on its own, without his Burst, as in the game; and Together We Rise passes once, to the first character switched in after him, who keeps it until it ends.

new: Optimize rotation now works on the Team optimize tab too: it tries thousands of rotations with your last run's builds and checks the best few with builds from your own artifacts and weapons.
The enemy can be set as one that can't be frozen (Stygian Onslaught bosses by default): Hydro and Cryo still react, but it never becomes Frozen, so no Shatter or Frozen bonuses.
Rotations: write N3-4 to play only the 3rd and 4th hits of a Normal Attack string, for when the string carries on after a Skill instead of starting over (for example N2 E N3-4).
improved: Danica's Skill, Anchor Normal Attacks, Will to Purge, Burst and Entry Skill follow timings measured in the game, and her rotation says why her Anchor ran out when a swap-in couldn't refresh it.

fixed: KQM share pictures name the artifact standard the builds used (Good, Great, Top, Perfect, Custom or Mixed) instead of always KQM Standards, and KQM's tooltips describe the new standards.

new: KQM artifacts now come in five standards: KQM Standard, Good, Great, Top and Perfect. Above KQM Standard, each artifact is built as the game makes one (4 different substats and 4 or 5 upgrades), so a build never has more substat rolls than five artifacts can hold (Top used to give 60; the most is 45). Perfect is the best set the game can make. Saved settings move to the nearest standard: run them again to refresh.
Teams from other sites open with one link: preview, import, then run them on their builds or switch to your own (link format: stellaroptimizer.com/import-spec).
fixed: What raises team damage: Level rows count the ascension that level needs, a talent at its ascension's cap shows no gain, and Wolf's Gravestone uptime counts as it does in the run's damage.
Team optimize results now show for teams where a member uses a TC build.

improved: Iansan: her Kinetic Energy Scale now restores Nightsoul points from the on-field member's movement, as in gcsim. Each action counts as 6 m of movement unless you write [movement=N] after it ([movement=0] for none), so her Burst's ATK bonus no longer drains away during a normal rotation.

fixed: Energy Recharge calculator: what a rotation filled in no longer stays once the rotation stops giving it. Lowering a character's constellation now removes that constellation's Energy, and Favonius and energy weapon triggers update the same way. Open the KQM tab and run it again to refresh its builds.

KQM Optimize rotation (Full): the better rotations found by every start stay listed while it searches, each compared with your rotation, a rotation no longer ends with a swap to someone who no longer plays first, and up to 25 are shown.

new: KQM Optimize rotation: a Full search. Besides your rotation, it tries every other member order and the built-in templates, searches from each until nothing nearby is better, then gets fresh KQM builds for the best ones and searches again with them. It finds the best rotation within reach of your plan. Quick still searches within a time limit.
improved: KQM Optimize rotation can move a member anywhere in the order (a support played right before the character who catches its particles), bring a member back on the field to refresh a buff, and counts the damage stats a lower Energy Recharge need frees. You choose what it may change (order, coming back, attack strings, skills and kit options), and its best rotations are checked with their own KQM builds.
fixed: KQM builds: Crystallize teams (like Navia's) now show the DPS they really get. An Archaic Petra the search was only trying used to pick up shards for the whole team, which read up to about 1.5% high.

KQM builds: the result is always scored on the rotation its final weapons and sets play. When two builds each change the rotation in the other's favor, the one that's better on its own rotation is kept.
Sucrose: the party's Elemental Mastery from her Mollis Favonius passive now applies only after her Elemental Skill or Burst hits. A rotation where she uses neither no longer gives it to the team.

improved: KQM Optimize rotation: a cleaner look. Each rotation found is shown in full with its DPS gain and the Energy Recharge each member needs, the best ones show while it searches, and the page stays smooth during the search.
fixed: Energy Recharge calculator: during a rotation, Energy particles now go to whoever is on the field when they land, so a support that uses its skill and swaps out quickly feeds the next character and lowers that character's Energy Recharge need. Turret and Favonius particles too, and the calculator shows each catcher's share when particles are split.
Lohen: both hits of his Charged Attack in Masterstroke now gain Joy, so N1 CA N1 CA fills it for Etched Into Bone and Soul.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: Optimize, on the rotation's line, looks for a better rotation. It starts from yours, tries thousands of small changes (step order, actions, Normal Attack lengths, kit options such as how many beams a Charged Attack takes) with the builds of your last KQM run, and lists the best ones with their DPS gain and the Energy Recharge each member needs. Your main DPS keeps its Burst and field time. Use one, then generate builds again for it.

KQM Theorycrafting: “What raises team damage” now shows under the results too. It shows what one more KQM substat roll, talent level or character level on each member's KQM build adds to the team's damage, and it is saved with the run.
Versions: choose which teams go in the share picture with tick boxes. The Versions panel and the share pictures also work better on phones.
improved: Rotation writer: your “First rotation only” is now played before the start as a setup and not counted, unless you tick Counted. When you count rotations from the start, teams with a first rotation now count the main rotation; tick Counted to count the first rotation again.
fixed: Team optimize with weapons: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers tried on a member who doesn't hold it now only buffs the character who takes the field when that member leaves it, not everyone all the time. Press “Use this rotation” again on a saved rotation to update it.
Nicole C6: every party member gets her A1 Guidance as soon as she is upgraded.
A walk (WK) in a rotation now ends the Normal Attack string, so the next attack starts again from N1.
Rotation timeline: Bennett's burst field now shows as his buff.
Silken Moon's Serenade now triggers on elemental attacks that apply an element without dealing damage, such as Nilou's Tranquility Aura.
Duplicate and New version: picking a member of the original team for a slot now works, and the members brought in keep their loadout.
Importing a database now shows everything you imported: the Artifacts, Weapons and Characters pages open without the filters saved in the file, and your sort order is kept.
Labels with a description show it only when you point at the label itself, not at the empty space next to it.

improved: Team optimize is faster again on teams with big rotations, often by half or more: each member's search no longer starts with a slow warm-up step when your GPU does the search.

fixed: Wriothesley C4: his Attack Speed bonus is now counted. In a Polestar Field (Radiance: Stellar-Conduct) he attacks 20% faster and the rest of the party 10%; outside it, an overflowing heal gives him +20% for 4 s on the field, or the party +10% for 6 s while he is off the field.

Wriothesley C6 in Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: the Stellar-Conduct hit of his third Repelling Fist now gets the C6 CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG bonus, and Luster: Vaulting Fist makes its C6 icicle even after Icefang Rush ends.
Anastasya's Lament for the Lost: with her in the party, a new Stellar Vortex now starts at Level 2 (at most once per second), as in the game.
ER calculator: Varesa's C2 now also restores 11.5 Energy when her Volcanic Kablam hits, not only on her Plunging Attacks.

new: Team optimize: a Search setting in the Optimize team window. Quick, the default, narrows very large searches to the artifacts that can matter: much faster, and it rarely misses the best build (by a little when it does). Full always searches every artifact.
improved: Team optimize runs are much faster: small searches now run on your GPU too, not only big ones. Runs on real inventories that took over a minute now take around 10 seconds.

ER calculator: Energy from constellations, passives, artifact sets and weapons is now filled into Bonus energy from the written rotation, for the member who gets it. This covers Mitya's C1, Yae's C1 and C4, Furina's C4, Xingqiu's C6, Raiden's Burst (from her Energy Recharge), Sara's A4, Venti's A4, the Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City 2-piece, The Dockhand's Assistant, Portable Power Saw and about 60 more.
KQM Theorycrafting keeps the generated builds of your last 100 teams instead of 6, so a team you ran earlier still shows its results when you come back to it.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: Versions. From the Versions button next to Share, make versions of a team with members swapped, other constellations, or a signature weapon set to R1–R5 or left out. Each version is a team of its own with its own rotation, and every version runs under the original's KQM settings, so they compare like for like. Run them all in the background, edit a version's rotation in place, duplicate one, make any version the original, and share them all as one picture.
Rotation writer: write hE[stacks=1] for Beidou's hold with one Polaris stack (hE alone holds for two).
improved: ER calculator: turrets (Fischl's Oz, Raiden's Eye, Yae's Sakuras, Xiangling's Guoba, Nahida, Kokomi, Zhongli and more) now count the particles they actually make in the written rotation. A turret that needs the party's hits, ends early, or is replaced by its own Burst no longer counts a full duration of particles.
ER calculator: Beidou's Polaris Energy and Diona's C1 Energy are now filled in from the written rotation, and Beidou's 1-stack hold counts as 1 stack for her particles.
fixed: Raiden's Eye of Stormy Judgement now lasts longer for members whose attacks pause on hit (hitlag), as in game, so it strikes more often with hard-hitting on-field characters.
Beidou's Lightning Storm bonus (A4) now starts when Tidecaller is released rather than when it hits.

Team optimize no longer counts a weapon or artifact passive that needs a shield (such as Calamity of Eshu's) while the written rotation has no shield on that member, even when its switch was left on. For a rotation written before this update, press Use this rotation once more.

improved: KQM Theorycrafting: with several refinements ticked for a weapon group, the builds now use the highest, and the lower ones are ranked for comparison (Battle Pass R1 and R5 ticked now builds at R5).
Anastasya at C6: the rotation's notes now say when her Honor strike went unused because the others' Sealing ended before her Skill was tapped, and how to keep it.
fixed: KQM Theorycrafting no longer runs out of memory on some teams whose rotation has random hits, such as Chasca with Ororon, Furina and Bennett.

new: KQM Theorycrafting can set each member's artifacts: every member in Setup has its own Artifacts choice (KQM Standard, Good, Great, Top or a custom number of rolls), and the Artifacts menu above still sets them all at once.

KQM Theorycrafting can lock a member's weapon: in Choose weapons, each weapon type has a Lock a weapon row. Every build of that member then uses the locked weapon, even if it isn't ticked, and the rest of the team is optimized around it.
improved: KQM Theorycrafting runs faster, most of all for teams with many buffs (up to about half the time).
fixed: Anastasya's ascension talent now adds 10% to the Stellar Swirl reaction multiplier (300% becomes 310%) instead of multiplying it, as the game does.

new: KQM Theorycrafting finds builds quicker by default: after the first round, each member only tries the weapons and artifact sets close to its best (and every one that helps the team or its Energy), and the rest are listed as screened out under the rankings. Search: Full in the setup tries every weapon and set in every round, as before.

fixed: KQM Theorycrafting's rotation no longer lists, under an attack's parts, the effects of artifact sets and weapons the builds don't hold, so an attack is split only where something that counts for the builds differs.

improved: A rotation note says when Danica's Skill drops no particles: both her Skills share one 14 s particle cooldown.
fixed: Equip on Team optimize puts the artifacts and weapons on the characters even when a member uses a saved build: that member switches to its equipped build and the saved build stays as it was. Equip is also still offered after Save as builds.
The Widsith plays the song picked in its switch in the rotation, instead of the average of the three.
Arlecchino's C2 Balemoon Bloodfire lands right after she absorbs the directive, before her next Normal Attack, so in Melt teams it Melts and no longer takes the Cryo her Normal Attacks need.

improved: The setting beside the rotation now says what it counts: Steady DPS (rot 3–4), the default, plays the rotation 4 times in a row and averages the last 2; First 1 to 6 rotations count from the start.

The parts of a grouped attack name what sets them apart: who is on the field, then the buffs that differ, each with its owner's picture and the characters' own buffs first. The Show buff conditions switch is gone.
Team optimize can copy the KQM Theorycrafting rotation, as KQM can copy Team optimize's, played at your own constellations. Neither button shows when the two rotations are already the same.
The team page header is more compact, with a back arrow to your teams.
KQM Theorycrafting: the passive switches in the weapon and artifact set choosers line up in columns.
fixed: stellaroptimizer.com: Polestar Field, Radiance and other reaction buffs showed internal names instead of their text, in Team settings and when editing an attack.
Team settings: buff descriptions no longer overlap the next column on wide screens.
A member's Overview no longer shows an empty card when there is nothing in it.

improved: Team optimize: an attack the rotation plays with different members on the field or different buffs up is now one row with its total. Open it to see each part, named by who is on the field.
Each member's rotation header counts its hits, as the rotation writer does, and its damage says DPS.
Attacks changed by hand after a rotation was played are marked "Attacks edited", and when playing the rotation again replaces those changes, the message says so (Undo is still there).

Rotation text: names that aren't in the team are listed in one warning, warnings name members in full, and full-width commas and semicolons work as step breaks. "Hits per rotation" explains why some hits are fractions.
Loadouts the app named itself show the character's name, as "Raiden Shogun Loadout".
Deleting a team says that its rotations and its Team optimize and KQM results go with it.
On phones, the button that leaves an artifact out of a team's runs is easier to tap.
fixed: The Feedback button and pop-up messages no longer cover the Optimize team button.
On phones, the written rotation uses the whole width of the screen.
KQM Theorycrafting: the setup's time to defeat the Radiant Moongecko now matches the results.
Closing the rotation writer keeps a "First rotation only" you haven't used yet, as it keeps the rotation, and Undo reverts both.
Closing the team name window with Esc keeps the name you typed.
An attack's buff conditions no longer show internal names.
When the team uses saved builds, Team optimize's header says Current DPS instead of Equipped DPS.
The "Could not copy" message can be closed, and goes away once the attacks change.
Importing text that isn't a team shows a plain message.

new: Undo equip on Team optimize puts back the equipment and saved builds the team had before the last Equip.
Export attacks and Import attacks move a rotation's attacks as JSON, and KQM Theorycrafting can copy Team optimize's current rotation into its own.
Team export can download the team as a JSON file, and the export now includes both of the team's written rotations.
improved: Written rotations are saved with their team: duplicating a team keeps them, with their opener and timing, and deleting a team removes them.
When no team matches the search on the Teams page, a Clear filters button brings them back, and an imported team opens right away.
The rotation writer's revert button just says Undo.
fixed: KQM Theorycrafting counts the Energy restored by Bloodsoaked Ruins, Jadefall's Splendor, Lumidouce Elegy and Amenoma Kageuchi, so a member holding one of them needs less Energy Recharge.
A new team no longer opens with the rotation of a team deleted before it, and deleting a team from its own page no longer shows an error.
A Team optimize or KQM result is shown as out of date once the team's members or a member's requirements change.
Importing a file that doesn't hold a valid team shows an error instead of adding an empty team.
When copying to the clipboard fails, a message says so and the JSON can be downloaded instead.
Team optimize says to add artifacts first when there are none to choose from, instead of running without any.
Opening a team no longer counts as an edit in the Teams page's Last edit order.

new: Built-in rotations: "Templates" in the rotation writer, and the start screen of an empty rotation, list standard rotations for the main DPS characters (your team's own first). Picking one opens it in the writer.

New rotation words: "WK" walks ("WK11f": 11 frames; Tartaglia's next Skill is his walking one), "HP" and "LP" are high and low plunges with "HP[collision]" for the hit on the way down (Xiao, Diluc), "CA[cancel]" cancels Arlecchino's Charged Attack before it hits, "CA[bullets=4]" fires Chasca's Shadowhunt after 4 bullets, "CA[weakspot]" aims at a weak point (Lyney, Prototype Crescent), and "D?/CA" dashes only when Wanderer's Descent is up, else a Charged Attack.
improved: Rotation damage: Geo resonance now comes from shields, and Crystallize shards are picked up on dashes (Itto and Navia teams); Kazuha absorbs Pyro inside Bennett's field and his Burst's damage over time keeps the stats it was cast with; Bennett's field ATK goes only to the member standing in it.

Finale of the Deep tracks its Bond of Life: heals wear it down, Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy stacks on each change, and Clorinde clearing her own Bond gives the full ATK bonus. Furina's Endless Waltz no longer heals twice when it is set off again.

Kit fixes: Cyno's Mortuary Rite with Thundering Fury, Fischl's Oz after a cut-short Burst and her Skill waiting for Oz to leave, Clorinde's Night Vigil, Navia's Crystal Shrapnel, Itto's Superlative Superstrength before his Burst, Wanderer's Windfavored, Xiao's and Diluc's plunges, Chasca's Shadowhunt and Tartaglia's walking Skill.
Team optimize and KQM respond faster: opening a member's attacks, switching to the KQM tab, and clicks while builds generate.
fixed: Mitya's Talent tab shows the total of a Gradient Detonation.
KQM Theorycrafting's Damage share follows the rotation that was played and counts each hit under the element it actually dealt, so the split by element and by attack matches the result.
Hovering a passive, buff, attack or weapon on Team optimize and KQM Theorycrafting while its text is still loading no longer blanks the page: the tooltip shows a placeholder until the text arrives.

A fight that starts with no energy no longer waits, in its first rotation, for what the Bursts would have made ready (Anastasya's Skills after her Burst, for example). What isn't ready is left out and the rotation goes on, as a player would, so teams like that defeat Stygian bosses much sooner in the estimate.
The fight timeline names the Domovoy Sculptor's statue blasts, Lysis Shears' cannon HP loss and the Guardian Blade's heal, which read "Horns broken".

new: Time to defeat now follows the mechanics of five more Stygian Onslaught bosses, from the game files: the Battle-Hardened Domovoy Sculptor, the Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow, the Chimeric Winged Lion and both Secret Source Automatons. The fight timeline shows each one's states, wards, shields and backlash.
Domovoy Sculptor: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer on it as it sculpts turns the sculptures into statues that explode on it and take its RES down, as the game does. Without Radiance it stays at 90% RES.

Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow: its Ice Coffin at 81% HP is worn down by the team's Pyro, Electro, Anemo and Geo, or turned into a shield by Radiance. A coffin that holds 20 s gives it 10% of its HP back, and a second coffin follows.
Chimeric Winged Lion: its Electro Ward is worn down by the team's reactions and by its own shockwave under Radiance. Breaking it brings the backlash, paralysis, flight and vortex.

Secret Source Automatons: the Overseer Device's Sweeper Modes stop under Cryo hits and turn to Forced Counterstrike with Nightsoul's Blessing; Lysis Shears' shield holds until Nightsoul's Blessing fills its Adaptive Countermeasures.

Team optimize works out each member's Min ER from the written rotation with the ER calculator, as KQM Theorycrafting does. The run window shows the targets, "Calculate ER" opens the same side panel to adjust them, and a run works them out for the weapons each build holds. Typing a member's minimum keeps your own values instead.
The fight timeline shows the team's damage in every 3 s, into a shield or ward too, and pointing at a bar shows the team's DPS in those 3 s.

On KQM Theorycrafting, a weapon row says when its passive is counted ("Passive on", or the share of the fight it is on), and a pick lists how it changes the teammates' Energy Recharge, for example with Favonius particles.
improved: KQM Theorycrafting keeps its own enemy, team buffs, kit switches and extra buffs, apart from Team optimize's, and never uses the switches or buffs of your own builds. A weapon passive switched off on Team optimize no longer changes KQM's results. The first time, KQM starts with a copy of Team optimize's.
Clicking the rotation opens the rotation writer at once, and the rotation time and the number of rotations sit at the end of the rotation's line, in a menu.
The rotation, setup and result sections each have their own colour, the toggles are redesigned, and Export and Import moved to the right of the header.
fixed: Switching the enemy from a Stygian boss to Custom no longer keeps the boss's HP.
The equipped team's DPS counts Wolf's Gravestone's passive as a run does, so it matches the result's DPS.
On Team optimize, the rotation timeline plays Team optimize's own rotation, not KQM's.

new: "If ready, else" in written rotations: "Q/N3" (or "Q?/N3") uses the Burst when it is ready and N3 when it is not ("E/N2CA" does the same for a Skill on cooldown). The rotation's notes say when the alternative was played.
KQM Theorycrafting keeps its own rotation, apart from Team optimize's, and plays it at the constellations set in its Setup. The first time, it starts as a copy of Team optimize's.

Changing a constellation plays the written rotation again by itself (your own on Team optimize, the Setup ones on KQM), and a notice says how the rotation time and attacks changed. For example, Zibai's C1 fifth Stride no longer doubles the rotation time.
Against the Radiant Moongecko, Team optimize picks builds with Disentangled's CRIT Rate and DMG Bonus in mind, so it no longer caps CRIT Rate without them.

Radiant Moongecko's fight is modelled from the game: its Moonstone Anchor's ward (9 layers of 4U Geo, 35 s) takes the team's damage, and breaking it moves 70% of the Geo DMG and 10% of the rest onto the boss (at most 40% of its HP). Radiant Cocoon lowers the team's CRIT Rate and DMG until it is healed to full, then Disentangled buffs it for 15 s.
For the Moongecko, the enemy box shows how long the team takes to break the ward (estimated from the rotation's Blunt hits) and when it is healed out of the cocoon; both can be changed.
The fight timeline shows the team's DPS over the fight, so you can line up Bursts with the boss's weak moments.
Stygian Onslaught fights start with no energy, as in the game: the first rotation is counted without its Bursts. "Energy at the start" in the enemy box switches it to full energy.
Wolf's Gravestone's passive (enemies under 30% HP) now counts for the part of the fight it is actually on, in Team optimize and KQM, whenever the enemy has HP.
Write a repeated group once with its count: "4[N5 CD]" (KQM's notation) or "4N5CD".
Varesa's rotation notes explain why a Burst or Skill waited.
fixed: The ER calculator updates by itself when the opener or timing settings change, not only the rotation text, and no longer assumes an energy weapon the build may not hold (Sandrone showed 100%).
With a Burst every 2nd or 3rd rotation, the other rotations still play short Bursts like Varesa's Volcanic Kablam and Flins' Thunderous Symphony.
Boss descriptions show the right element and reaction icons.
While the GPU optimizer runs, progress shows as a share instead of a huge combination count.
"What raises team damage" says its rows are one average substat roll.

new: Stygian Onslaught bosses as the enemy: pick one from a catalogue with each boss's icon, HP, RES and the game's description, at Fearless or Dire, and its level and RES are set at once. The enemy editor is redesigned around it: a custom enemy or a Stygian boss.

How long your builds take to defeat the enemy, beside its HP in Team optimize and KQM Theorycrafting. Wavebinder's Courage, drinks and Valiant Assaults are counted, so Stellar Glimmer teams face fewer of them; for now the other bosses are mostly their HP divided by the team's DPS.

A fight timeline under the results: the boss's states, its HP and Wavebinder's Courage over the fight. Point at a moment (or click to pin it) to read its HP, Courage, RES, the team's DPS there and what its shield has taken.
A custom enemy can have HP too (type 20M, 1.5B or 20,000,000) to see how long the builds take to defeat it.
Team optimize: choose whose artifacts the team may borrow, as the solo optimizer can.
Team optimize shows the enemy as KQM Theorycrafting does, and its results now include the rotation timeline, played with the result's weapons and artifact sets.

The rotation writer is redesigned: the rotation is coloured as you type, with unknown words underlined; the name and action chips insert into the box you're typing in, First rotation only included; a How to write it sheet; and one chip for the time spent waiting for cooldowns.
improved: KQM Theorycrafting's setup shows the enemy beside the members, with its HP and time to defeat as figures.
A pinned moment on the writer's timeline is shown once, and Hits per rotation names each attack once, with its other parts (Stellar-Conduct, DoT) under it.
Rotation notes say when Danica's E ends Maid: Royal Guard and her Burst's party ATK, and how to set Sandrone's condensed beams (CA[beams=N]).
fixed: Anastasya's Blessed Spear N3 can be cancelled by a dash or her Skill almost at once, as in footage.
Danica's Elemental Burst cooldown starts 0.4 s into the cast, as in the game, so her Bursts are 18.4 s apart in a written rotation.
Anastasya's Lament for the Lost adds 1 Polestar Field stack instead of 2, as in the latest beta.

improved: KQM Theorycrafting generates builds about 30% faster.
fixed: Phones: the character picker's Done button no longer hides under Android Chrome's bottom bar, and it sits beside the pick count.

improved: KQM builds now use 10/10/10 talents by default, as the current KQM Standards do. If you pick 9/9/9 instead, new teams start with your last pick.

Phones: every team tab is in view (Team optimize and KQM were off-screen), Feedback moved into the menu and footer so nothing covers the Optimize team button, "Use this rotation" stays at the bottom of the screen, and attack lists stay folded after you apply a written rotation.

Phones: the character picker shows each pick's team order and no longer opens the keyboard, timelines show avatars so the chart has more room, ER targets are no longer cut off, and the home page shows your inventory as compact tiles.
fixed: Team optimize: the Optimize team button stays usable when every member is switched off, so you can turn them back on (it used to lock).
Team optimize says when every member is on a TC build, and warns when a member has no artifacts to choose from.
The rotation summary shows waits as written (W1f), not as long decimals.

new: The KQM tab is now three clear steps: 1 Rotation, 2 Setup and 3 Team builds, with the team's builds raised as the result.
Damage share beside Top builds: each member's share of the team's damage, and the damage by element.

The rotation timeline under the KQM results, played with the builds shown. Click an attack to see its damage and the buffs during it; an action with several hits (Mitya's Gradient Detonation) lists them as tabs, most damage first.
Pin a moment on the timeline to see each member's stats then and what every buff gives at that moment ("Elemental Burst +400 ATK"), with the time it has left.
An empty rotation now starts with a choice: write the rotation, or add attacks yourself (or import one).
Rotations can swap a member in and straight out: write "Danica" (or "Danica entry") on its own to play just her Entry Skill, and the rotation says why when no Entry happens.
improved: KQM builds now assume C2 for standard 5★ characters (Jean, Diluc, Mona, Keqing, Qiqi, Tighnari, Dehya, Mizuki) and C1 for the 5★ characters in the free constellation event; other 5★ stay at C0 and 4★ at C6. Each can still be changed in Setup.
Top builds show only what changes from the best build, or every member's gear with the All gear switch.
The run summary above the results is shorter: weapons and artifact sets read Default or Custom, and the ER target Auto-calculated or Custom.

An attack's buffs read as where they come from and what they give ("Elemental Skill −30% Electro RES"), with the condition in the tooltip. Effects the hit doesn't use are faded, buffs with no effect are folded into one list, and the enemy's aura when the hit lands is shown.
A buff that only counts together with another is listed once, on the one that gives the effect, with the other's setting on it.
The detailed timeline has a full-screen button, and clicking a bar there pins its moment instead of closing the window.
The On field setting shows only when attacks were added by hand: a written rotation already says who is on the field for each attack.

new: Share → Constellations: compare each member's constellations by team DPS and their own DPS. Write another rotation for a constellation that plays differently (it carries to the higher ones), then make every member's chart with one click.

Constellation investment, the Team tab of the Constellations picture: the team's best constellations at each cost, counting copies (a 5★ is 1 at C0, each constellation 1 more). Rotations for combinations of constellations can be set under Advanced.

The ER calculator, redone: members as tabs, every setting in clear sections, a bar showing where each member's energy comes from against what its Bursts cost, its own Thunderous Symphony or Kablam count, and a tip for each character.
KQM Setup: choose the artifact standard: KQM Standards' 20 distributed rolls, or 25, 30, 40 or a custom number for better-farmed builds. The setup, the run summary and each build show it.
A Feedback button at the bottom right: report a bug or share an idea, with screenshots (add, drop or paste them).
improved: Rotation timeline: a scrollbar you can see, one pin shared with the detailed view, Escape to unpin, a legend for the buffs, and a detailed view that no longer jumps while you scrub.
Share: the team card shows the team as you picked it (another weapon or sets, a top team), and the charts' character art stands beside the bars, sized and centred for the list.
Sandrone's Charged Attack fires 3 beams at every constellation unless the rotation says otherwise (CA[beams=6] from C1), so a rotation plays the same at C1.
The ER calculator counts per rotation as the KQM run plays it (the written rotation's own length).
fixed: Weapon groups with several refinements ticked (R1 + R5) build at the group's usual refinement (Battle Pass R1, 4★ standard wish R5) and show the others as compared rows; the weapon chart's 100% is at that refinement.

ER calculator: the written rotation fills Skill uses and options correctly for more characters (Kazuha, Arlecchino, Cyno, Wanderer, Xilonen, Tartaglia, Amber, Alhaitham, Wriothesley and others), counts Ineffa's C4 Energy and fills in Exaiphanes Blade's triggers.
Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers: with a written rotation, only the wielder's switch-outs give its ATK (once every 20 s, to the member who comes in).
Flins: the rotation says when an E comes after Manifest Flame has ended (it starts it again and the next Q is a full Burst). Two Thunderous Symphonies fit at C0, three from C1.
Anastasya's and Danica's talent and constellation icons are the game's own.

new: Share your KQM results as pictures for Discord, Reddit or X (the Share button above the results): a theorycrafting team card with each member's weapon, sets, damage share, field time and Energy Recharge and the rotation, and weapon and artifact set charts for each member, measured against the best weapon from the default list. Every picture notes the version and the date, and pictures with beta characters, weapons or sets are marked as beta.

Weapon groups can count several refinements at once, for example R1 and R5: builds use the highest, and the rankings and weapon charts show each weapon at the others too. Favonius, Sacrificial and the other 4★ standard wish weapons now have their own group (R5 by default).
improved: "Opener counted" sits beside the rotation count in the KQM run settings: the same switch as the writer's "Counted" for First rotation only.

new: Anastasya C6: her Honor strike (Doom's third attack at 250%, with every member's Accolades) is used by tapping her Skill while the others are still Sealed, with no cooldown, so write it right after her Burst: "hE Q E N5D N5D E E E".
You can stop Anastasya's Doom after two stages and swap: the next rotation starts with her hold Skill again.
fixed: Anastasya: one Blessed Spear N5 string ends the others' Sealing, leaving the field ends the Blessing of Honor and Doom, and a hold Skill ends the Blessing of Love, as in the game.

Danica: her Skill ends her Maid form and her Burst's buff window, as in the game; use her Skill before swapping back in for her Burst to keep Royal Guard. A Burst cast first now also enhances a later Will to Purge, its DMG bonus multiplies the base DMG, and her C2 Toast counts once.
ER calculator: Danica's C1 and C4 Energy is counted from the written rotation.
Mitya: his C4 strike gets C6's 115% with a Steady core and counts Beacons across Skills; his detonation and hold Skill no longer count Beacons the game doesn't give.
Odette: her C6 self Elevation needs her Dance Double out, Snow Swan's Dream starts when her Burst is cast, and the Double's Stellar moves last until it leaves.

Danica and the Tsaritsa follow the 7.3 beta (7.2.52) kit changes: the Tsaritsa ascends with CRIT DMG (38.4% at 90) instead of CRIT Rate, has higher Blessed Spear and Palestar Edict: Doom Stellar Glimmer multipliers, an 18s Burst cooldown, 10% Stellar Swirl base coefficient (A4), 50% Love Stellar Glimmer CRIT DMG (C2), 200% C6 Triumph and 250% C6 Doom multipliers, and keeps C6 Honor's 20% Elevation after teammates unseal.

Danica's Maid: Royal Guard burst ATK buff is 10% up to 400 at Lv10 (18s Burst cooldown, 16s Will to Protect cooldown), C1 Royal Guard burst boost is 100%, C2 is reworked (10 Let Us Toast stacks at 80% ATK, up to 2 at 350% ATK in Maid: Cleaner, and a once-per-combat 150% Cleaning Decree Will to Purge hit), and C6 grants 15% Stellar-Conduct Elevation.

new: Weapons now follow your written rotation: for 4★ and 5★ weapons, timed buffs, stacks, their cooldowns and weapon damage procs (Skyward, Prototype, The Flute, Kagotsurube Isshin and more) count from the hits and actions that trigger them.

Weapons that react to healing (Song of Stillness, Tidal Shadow, Dialogues of the Desert Sages and others) now count heals from Diona, Qiqi, Yaoyao, Charlotte, Chevreuse, Sayu and Iansan, and heals by Max HP % (Gaming, Furina, Neuvillette, Wriothesley, Lyney).

ER calculator: Energy from Amenoma Kageuchi, Everlasting Moonglow, Kitain Cross Spear, Katsuragikiri Nagamasa, Frostbreath and other energy weapons is counted from the written rotation, and Favonius below R5 procs less often, as in the game.
The rotation writer reads KQM's Mavuika notation: C3 holds her Flamestrider Charged Attack for 3 spins and F waits for its finisher, as in "C3FD C3FD CF".
fixed: Navia's Verdict gets its Seals from the Crystallize shards she and Gorou pull in.
A Thousand Blazing Suns' Nightsoul boost counts for the wielder's hits during Nightsoul's Blessing, and the Ring Mavuika leaves when she swaps out keeps hitting.
Frostbreath's ATK buff lasts only as its wielder's Cryo- and Hydro-related reactions keep it up.
The Unforged, Summit Shaper, Memory of Dust and Vortex Vanquisher build their Golden Majesty stacks from the wielder's hits instead of always counting 5.
Attacks that take their stats when cast (Xiao's Skill, Zhongli's Stone Stele and others) now count weapon and set buffs that were up at the cast.
Amos' Bow gives Ganyu's Frostflake Bloom its 4 stacks for the arrow's flight.
Tulaytullah's Remembrance, Song of Broken Pines and Cashflow Supervision speed up Normal Attacks in the rotation.

KQM: weapon buffs a rotation can't show (Talking Stick, Wine and Song, Prospector's Drill and others) are no longer counted by default, and weapons such as Mistsplitter Reforged, Azurelight and Haran Geppaku Futsu count only what the member's attacks can give.

new: KQM: the ER targets from the ER calculator now apply by themselves when you use or change the rotation; there's no need to open Calculate ER and press Apply. Targets you type by hand stay until the rotation changes.
ER calculator: the random Energy from each member's Normal and Charged Attack hits is now counted from your written rotation (in Bonus energy).
fixed: The rotation's steps on the page keep each name and its actions on one line; on Windows the actions sat slightly higher than the names.

new: The rotation writer is wider and split into clear sections: the rotation, its time and timeline, and hits per rotation.
The Rotations setting (Repeating, or the first 1–6 from the start) is now on the page beside the rotation; changing it updates the rotation in use.
fixed: KQM tab: teams with Flins no longer crash with "Unexpected Error Occurred" when the ER targets come from the calculator.

new: Rotation writer: choose whether to count the repeating pace or only the first 1 to 6 rotations from the start, with every cooldown ready (as in a timed challenge's first rotation). Team optimize and the KQM tab use the same choice.
fixed: KQM tab: builds can now pair two sets with the same 2-piece bonus, such as Gladiator's Finale + Shimenawa's Reminiscence (ATK) or Wanderer's Troupe + Gilded Dreams (Elemental Mastery).
A rotation that opens by waiting for a cooldown now shows the wait at its end instead of its start.
Mitya: when his second tap E comes too late to switch his Detection Core, the writer says it is a new Skill and why it waits.
The rotation writer's button is now called "Write rotation".

Rotation writer: ping now sets the swap time instead of delaying every action. A swap waits for the server, so it takes about twice your ping (100 ms is 12 frames, the KQM standard), and attacks, Skills and Bursts keep their own timing.
The Human timing preset is gone: type your ping instead, or use the KQM standard button to go back to 12 frames.

ER calculator: Flins' particles now come from his Manifest Flame normal attacks (one every 2 s), Thunderous Symphony counts as its own 30-Energy Burst next to his 80-Energy one, and his C1 gives 8 Energy on the party's Lunar-Charged.
ER calculator: a Burst cadence you set by hand no longer counts Thunderous Symphony or Volcanic Kablam on top of it.
Prototype Amber's Energy now counts once per Burst of its wielder.
KQM tab: Deathmatch now counts a single opponent (ATK +24% at R1) instead of the bonus for two or more.

new: The KQM ER calculator now fills in each member's field time, skill uses, Burst cadence, particle catcher and Electro resonance from your written rotation; anything you change yourself stays, and "Use rotation" brings the rotation's values back.
Timeline: weapon and set effects that last the whole rotation now show as gold lines and are named at each moment, instead of only inside "Always on".
fixed: Long written rotations no longer lose attacks past the 40th per member, which cut their damage (for example Emilie's Burning and Lumidouce Case hits). Use your written rotation again to update a saved team.
Clash of Kings' ATK and Elemental Mastery bonus now lasts 6 s after the wielder's Skill (once every 12 s), and a Charged Attack hit while it's up adds 6 s once; it was counted for the whole rotation.
KQM tab: the timeline shows the set effects KQM counts by rule (such as Disenchantment in Deep Shadow), and buff lists no longer show sets a build doesn't wear.
Sandrone's Charged Attack after a pause now includes its wind-up, so rotations with waits are timed correctly.
Varesa's plunges now deal their falling hit.
ER calculator: Durin's Skill counts the Energy it restores, Varesa's Volcanic Kablam counts as her 30-Energy short Burst, and Sandrone starts at 5 particles and 5 bonus Energy.
The rotation's wait note now says when it waits for cooldowns left from the previous rotation.

new: KQM builds now find team setups where one member hands a set to a teammate (for example Danica taking Tenacity of the Millelith from Odette), worth up to a few percent more team DPS.

Shields now count in rotations: Angelos Heptades, Starcaller's Watch, Fractured Halo and the weapons and sets that work while shielded (The Bell, The Unforged, Summit Shaper, Memory of Dust, Vortex Vanquisher, Calamity of Eshu, Retracing Bolide) turn on while your team's shields are up, and Beacon of the Reed Sea's HP bonus while you're not shielded.
Rotation writer: write CA[beams=2] to choose how many beams Sandrone fires in a Charged Attack (up to 3, or 6 from C1).
fixed: Fischl's Skill summons a new Oz whenever it is ready, even while Oz is still out (after a Sacrificial reset, or with her Burst's Oz up); it only calls Oz back while on cooldown. Fischl teams were counted up to 16% low.
Bloom, Hyperbloom and Burgeon deal damage at most twice every 0.5 s per character, as in the game; Hyperbloom teams were counted too high.
Alhaitham's Projection Attacks follow their in-game cooldown (his hitlag lengthens it), so they no longer use up the Electro and Hydro that Lunar-Charged needs.
Sandrone releases her Charged Attack right after her last beam, so her rotations are about 1 s shorter and her DPS is higher.
Zhongli's stele now resonates with Lunar-Crystallize's Moondrifts, recasting Albedo's, Ningguang's or Itto's construct no longer counts it twice, and Chiori's A4 triggers on every construct created.
Rainbow Serpent's Rainbow, Tidal Shadow and Song of Stillness now turn on when the rotation triggers them.
Freminet's Pressure Level now builds correctly when a Normal Attack string starts just before his Burst's Stalking ends.
With two non-Moonsign members, Ascendant Gleam now comes from the latest one to use a Skill or Burst.
A team's only Hexerei member now gets its Witch's Homework bonuses (for example A Day Carved From Rising Winds' CRIT Rate); Secret Rite effects still need two Hexerei.

new: The ER calculator counts every energy weapon from its game text (Lumidouce Elegy, Dialogues of the Desert Sages, Tome of the Eternal Flow, Frostbreath and more), each at most once per its cooldown.
The ER calculator counts The Exile's 4-piece: 6 Energy to each other member per Burst of the wearer.
The rotation writer shows the time per rotation as Team Optimize and KQM count it, and when a rotation has to wait for a cooldown, how long it takes without waiting and what it waits for.
The KQM tab's timeline shows the weapon and set buffs of the builds shown, each named by its weapon or set.
The timeline fits a phone in landscape: the detailed view opens full screen and the writer is one column.
The weapon chooser in Team optimize has a None button: untick everything, then tick just the weapons you want.
fixed: Heart of the Furnace's 4-piece now needs the wearer's own Stellar Glimmer hits or reactions and lasts 12 s; it was counted all rotation whenever anyone in the team made Stellar reactions.
Instructor's 4-piece now needs the wearer to trigger the reaction while on the field.
Shimenawa's Reminiscence lasts 10 s after the wearer's Skill on the field; it was counted all rotation.
Gilded Dreams' 4-piece now counts in KQM, for 8 s after the wearer's own reactions (once every 8 s); KQM always had it off.
Disenchantment in Deep Shadow's CRIT Rate now counts while Superconduct or the Polestar field is on the enemy; it never counted.
Finale of the Deep Galleries counts only for characters without Energy (Skirk, Mavuika), and its two halves lock each other out for 6 s; it was counted for everyone.
Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City: Spread counts as Dendro only, and Hyperbloom and Burgeon now trigger it.
A Day Carved From Rising Winds needs the wearer's own Normal, Charged, Skill or Burst hits and lasts 6 s; it was on for everyone.
Crimson Witch of Flames: each Skill refreshes all its stacks, as in the game.
Deepwood Memories is triggered by the wearer's Skill and Burst hits of any element, not by Dendro hits.
Nymph's Dream counts one stack per kind of attack the wearer landed on the field in the last 8 s; it was counted at 3 stacks.
Long Night's Oath stacks come from the wearer's Plunging, Charged and Skill hits on the field, 6 s each, up to 5.
Legacy of the First Chronicle gives one Starspark per Normal Attack; it was counted twice.
Martial Artist lasts 8 s after the Skill and Maiden Beloved 10 s after the Skill or Burst; they were counted all rotation.
Lavawalker, Thundersoother and Blizzard Strayer count hit by hit from the enemy's element at that hit, KQM's candidate sets too.
A set's switch turned on by hand no longer keeps its effect on all rotation when the rotation never triggers it (for example, Viridescent Venerer's shred of an element nobody swirls).

Without a written rotation: Aubade of Morningstar and Moon counts for members that make no Normal or Charged Attacks, Husk of Opulent Dreams only for Geo characters, and Berserker, Brave Heart and Tiny Miracle are off.
Team Optimize counts a rotation's real pace: a rotation that uses a skill faster than its cooldown allows was counted at its first, fastest time.
KQM: a character you set to use their Burst every 2nd or 3rd rotation in the ER calculator now does so in the played rotation, instead of waiting for it every time.
The rotation text now understands character names in your language (Russian, Chinese and so on), and a rotation written without arrows between characters is read correctly.
The timeline no longer disappears behind the hit cards on a laptop screen at 100% zoom.

new: Your data now live in the browser's database (IndexedDB) instead of local storage, so the 5 MB storage limit is gone. Everything moves over by itself on your first visit, and every entry is checked before the old copy is removed.
Saving happens in the background and no longer stalls the page. If a save ever fails, a notice says so and leaving the page asks first.
Saved KQM results take about a fifth of the space they did.
The rotation writer's hit cards show each attack in its own colour, as the rotation panel does.
fixed: Sandrone's Stellar-Swirl charged beam used the Stellar-Conduct multiplier; it now uses its own, higher one.
Exaiphanes Blade's ATK bonus at R4 and R5 is 32% and 40%, as in the game.
DEF reduction is capped at 90%, as in the game.
Team buffs from elemental resonance and reactions say so in their tooltip, instead of naming the active character.
Theorycraft: when no substat distribution meets your stat filters, your substats are kept and a warning says so; they used to be overwritten.
Optimize: a target that adds up to nothing (for example, its talent conditional is off) can't be started, and the button's tooltip says why.
Team import: errors show in the import dialog, and pasting a character's multi-target setup tells you where to import it.

new: Rotation writer: point at any moment of the timeline to read it (who is on the field, the enemy's aura, stacks, the hit there and its damage), and click to pin it. "Detailed timeline" opens a large window with the enemy's aura, every stack and resource over time, each member's buffs, the damage as it adds up, and a card for each member showing their stats, stacks and buffs at that moment.
The Teams page is redesigned: each member is a game-style card with their weapon, artifact sets and main stats, hover any of them for details, and every team shows its elemental resonance.

KQM Theorycrafting: Instructor and The Exile can be chosen, counted by KQM Standards for 4★ artifacts (lower main stats, 0.8 of the substats and 2 fewer distributed rolls for each 4★ piece, one 5★ off-piece).
KQM Theorycrafting: each weapon group's refinement (R1 to R5) is chosen right in the setup.
improved: Rotation writer: each member's hits are cards with every attack's share, and the notes fold behind one line.
fixed: KQM Theorycrafting: the rotation preview and timeline on the KQM tab play at the constellations set in KQM Setup, not your own.
Heretic's Molten Blade counts only after its wielder's Elemental Skill while they are on the field, not for every hit.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: the attacks of the rotation played for the builds open to show each buff up during the attack, what it gives and how much it adds, and the hit's stats, all for the builds shown. Picking other equipment in the results updates the rotation's attacks and damage.
fixed: Moonpiercer's ATK counts only when its wielder triggers Dendro reactions itself, as for Sapwood Blade and Forest Regalia, so it no longer ranks first in teams without Dendro.

KQM Theorycrafting: a weapon that changes a teammate's Energy Recharge requirement (Favonius) is scored with that teammate's artifacts built again, so the Energy Recharge it frees turns into damage, and picking another weapon never leaves a teammate short of its Energy Recharge.
KQM Theorycrafting: an attack opened before a run, or with an older run, no longer shows its buffs loading forever.

improved: KQM Theorycrafting: the setup has a Weapons and artifact sets section. Battle Pass, 4★ event wish, 5★ standard wish and 5★ event wish weapons switch on and off right there, each showing the refinement it counts at; Choose weapons and Choose sets pick them one by one.
fixed: The Widsith counts the average of its three songs, for 10 s each time its wielder takes the field (once per 30 s), instead of always its ATK song. Its passive also has an "Average of the three" option.

Rotation writer: tapping Mitya's Skill again to switch his Detection Core between modes no longer detonates his Gradient Beacons, so his next Charged Attack in Overload is a Gradient Detonation that spends them. As in game, only a Steady core detonates them: when it ends, or when his Skill is tapped or held anew after its cooldown.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: Top teams, under the member inspector: the best team, then the best teams that change one member's weapon or artifact sets, each with its team DPS and how far it is from the best. The member that changes stands out; pick a team to see it. The top 50 open in a window.

Rotation writer: a wait while Mualani surfs in Nightsoul's Blessing builds Wave Momentum, as walking does in game, so "E W90f N1" plays a Surging Bite. Waits can now be written in frames: W90f is 90 frames.
KQM Theorycrafting: member cards show the weapon and artifact sets of each build, and the constellation as a badge.
improved: KQM Theorycrafting generates builds about 4 times faster, with the same results.
fixed: KQM Theorycrafting now counts what a set or weapon does in the rotation before it is picked, so sets like Viridescent Venerer are chosen when their effect helps the team (Stellar Swirl teams no longer stay on Blizzard Strayer).
KQM Theorycrafting: picking another weapon or set in a result plays the rotation again with it, so the buffs and debuffs it gives the team are counted.
KQM Theorycrafting gives a weapon the game has one copy of (Exaiphanes' Blade and other quest rewards) to one member at most.
Rotation writer: Mualani's surfing jumps, dashes and bites no longer delay her next Skill, so every rotation plays its Surging Bites.
Epochal Advent's 4-piece bonus counts while the wearer is off the field again.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: picking another weapon or set now updates the team DPS and every member card, and picks for several members add up.
KQM Theorycrafting: each member card shows how many rolls went to each substat (hover for fixed, added and total); the same line sits next to Artifact totals.
Rotation timeline: each swap now shows as its own block before the next member's actions.

Frame data: actions that change in a mode or stance (Zibai's Spirit Steed's Stride, Wanderer's Windfavored attacks, Raiden's Musou Isshin and more) have their own rows, so editing one no longer changes the other.

KQM Theorycrafting (Beta): a new tab on every team. It builds each member from KQM-standard artifacts and the weapons you allow, for the team's rotation, and ranks the sets and weapons for each member. Runs keep going in the background, and the last result is still there after a reload.
Team Optimize: write a rotation as text, like “Odette EE -> Mitya E -> Sandrone Q”. It is played out with each character's frame data: cooldowns, energy, reactions and when buffs are up.
Team Optimize has a cleaner look, with details in tooltips, and “What raises team damage” now stays with the saved result.
fixed: Every character released or buffed since 5.0 now follows the game text at every constellation.
Many older characters' buffs and constellations now follow the game text too.

new: Team Optimize: exclude artifacts from a team's optimization. Press ⊘ on an artifact in a result, or find artifacts by set, slot and main stat under Optimize team → Excluded artifacts, where each can be used again.

fixed: Optimize and Team Optimize keep running at full speed when the tab is in the background or the window is minimised.
Anastasya: her C2 and C6 bonuses now show their Stellar Swirl lines too (the damage already counted them).

improved: Danica and the Tsaritsa follow the latest beta data: the Tsaritsa's Palestar Crown and her burst's Stellar Glimmer bonus are lower.
The upcoming artifact sets have their official names, Epochal Advent and Empyrean Sojourn.
fixed: Epochal Advent's 4-piece bonus only counts while the wearer is on the field, as in the latest beta.

title: Build cards
new: Build card: a picture of a character's build to download or copy, from the character page or a team member's page. It shows the character's art, constellation, talents, weapon, artifacts with their Roll Value and Crit Value, the artifacts' totals and the character's own stats.
Choose which substats count toward a character's Roll Value on its build card; the others are dimmed.
Team card in Team Optimize results: the team's DPS and rotation, then every member's build card with its share of the damage, in one picture.

title: The first Stellar Optimizer release
new: Team Optimize: optimize the whole team's artifacts and weapons for one rotation, with energy weapons, member swaps, the closest build when a requirement can't be met, and the next best team builds.
Improve tab (formerly the Artifact Upgrader), with a built-in substat value and a what-to-farm strip.
One-click theorycraft of any build, with its best roll distribution.
Mitya and Valeriy, with their weapons, from beta data ahead of their release.
The unreleased characters Danica and Anastasya, with the upcoming weapons and artifact sets.
A best-build page for every character, and an FAQ.
This changelog, links to the source on GitHub and a Buy me a coffee link.
improved: A much faster artifact optimizer: a new search engine, sped up with WebGPU where the browser supports it.
A new look: dark theme, compact navigation, a home dashboard, and redesigned Optimize tab, filters and character cards.
Pages answer clicks at once, art loads as WebP, and the site always runs its latest version.
Official Chinese terms, and stat names that can be translated.
No ads; privacy-friendly analytics without cookies.
fixed: Team Optimize keeps each member to its allowed sets: a member takes the pieces its sets need from a teammate, or the run tells you who can't fit.
Team Optimize no longer keeps a weapon left out of "Weapons to choose from" when a ticked one was free.
